title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Here Are All The Songs We Heard In Rockstar's In-Game Radio Preview
summary: The studio released a preview of hosts and songs we can expect to hear on six of GTAVI's radio stations. - Game Informer

The stations feature Latin music, southern hip hop, country, metal, AfroBeats, and pop , and I just finished listening to each preview. While listening, I used my phone's Shazam feature to create a list of all the songs I heard in the previews. Below, I'll list each station and the songs I caught. Cocotea FM EoO - Bad Bunny Si Es Trucho Es Trucho (Remix) - Axel Rulay featuring Farruko & El Afla Canalla - Romeo Santos & El Chaval de la Bachata Back Country Radio Need a Little Time Off for Bad Behavior - David Allan Coe Don’t Come Home a Drinkin’ - Loretta Lyn The Conversation - Hank Williams, Jr & Waylon Jennings AfroBank FM Joha - Asake Gye Wani - Pat Thomas featuring Ebo Taylor Shay’sana - DJ Lag & Robot Boii featuring Kamo Mphela The Chamber 106.6 I - Black Sabbath I’m Broken - Pantera Raining Blood - Slayer Flash FM Good Ones - Charli XCX Electric Feel - MGMT Midnight Sun (Girls Trip) - Zara Larsson & PinkPantheress Dirty South Classics Like a Pimp Mix - JefeEdai Who Dat - JT Money Born N Raided - DJ Khaled (featuring Pitbull, Trick Daddy, & Rick Ross) And those are all the songs I heard on these stations. Then read how Grand Theft Auto VI features tropical storms and hurricanes , and how it also includes over 170 animal species .
